message: Hey Jane, I've been really worried about Sarah. How is she doing today? Any updates would be really appreciated.
Reminder: Staff meeting at 3 PM in the main conference room.
Jane, don't forget to update the patient charts before noon. Thanks!
Good morning team, please review the updated safety protocols in your email.
Alert: The system will undergo maintenance tonight from 12 AM to 4 AM. Please save your work.
Jane, your compassion with the patients truly inspires us all. Thank you for your hard work!
Jane, I can't tell you how much your support means to me. I've been thinking a lot about my life and what I want to change when I get out of here.
